quote: Whenever an illuminated flashing red or yellow signal is used in conjunction with an official traffic-control device, it shall require obedience by vehicular traffic as follows: When a red lens is illuminated with rapid intermittent flashes, drivers of vehicles shall stop before entering the nearest crosswalk in an intersection or at a limit line when marked, or, if none, then before entering the intersection, and the right to proceed shall be subject to the rules applicable after making a required stop.

activation.condition: Illuminated flashing red signal used with an official traffic-control device.

obligation.description: Stop before the source-surveyed crosswalk, marked limit line, or unmarked intersection entry.

timing.description: Observe rapid intermittent red and complete cessation before entry; retain post-stop history.

judgment_calls_needed.note: Review official device identity and which approach it governs.

judgment_calls_needed.phrase: nearest crosswalk in an intersection or at a limit line when marked, or, if none, then before entering the intersection
judgment_calls_needed.note: Review the actual surveyed stop reference; do not infer an extra priority or numeric tolerance.

judgment_calls_needed.phrase: rules applicable after making a required stop
judgment_calls_needed.note: Preserve incorporated post-stop rules for independent source review.

parameter_refs.range_or_domain: crosswalk, marked line or unmarked entry
